operations.summary: Updates phone by id; fires trigger that unconditionally overwrites email_normalized with lower(email)
Updates email by id; fires trigger that recomputes email_normalized as lower(email) without plus-tag stripping
Writes stripped canonical email_normalized directly; trigger unconditionally overwrites it with lower(email)

conflicts.risk_explanation: update_phone fires unconditional BEFORE UPDATE trigger NEW.email_normalized:=lower(NEW.email). It rewrites normalized even when email is unchanged, discarding a plus-stripped canonical written by set_normalized_email on the same row. Different columns should both survive; trigger causes lost canonical.

update_email trigger recomputes normalized as lower(email) keeping plus-tag, while set_normalized_email writes stripped canonical e.g. user@example.com from User+tag@Example.com. Unconditional trigger discards the explicit canonical write in the same statement and races with concurrent canonical write, leaving lower-with-plus instead of stripped value.

Both old-release writes fire the same unconditional trigger. A phone-only update recomputes normalized from old email as lower() with plus-tag, which can clobber a just-committed email move and leave normalized inconsistent with final email instead of tracking stripped canonical of final email.

tests.name: phone_vs_canonical_same_row
tests.rationale: Old update_phone trigger sets normalized to lower(email) with plus-tag, clobbering new-release stripped canonical on same row. Both columns should survive; buggy code loses canonical.

invariants.description: stripped canonical should survive unrelated phone update

tests.name: email_vs_canonical_consistent_pair
tests.rationale: Email and canonical writers agree on new address. Correct code ends with email plus-address and stripped canonical regardless of order; buggy lower() trigger leaves plus-tag or discards explicit canonical.

invariants.description: final normalized is stripped canonical of new email

tests.name: phone_vs_email_tracking
tests.rationale: Concurrent phone and email updates to same row should both survive with normalized as stripped canonical of final email. Unconditional lower() trigger produces plus-tag value and phone update can overwrite email's normalized mapping.

invariants.description: normalized tracks stripped canonical of final email
